theater: 洛陽紫微城（玄武門、迎仙院）

battle.name: 神龍政變
battle.theater: 洛陽紫微城（玄武門、迎仙院）
battle.brief: 公元705年1月16日夜，中書令崔玄暐、兵部尚書張建之等六臣，藉右武衛將軍王孝傑掌握的北衙禁軍，夜襲紫微城迎仙院，殺張易之、張昌宗與武三思，逼武則天退位，立李顯為唐中宗，一日而事成。卡面斯巴達長矛未曾在洛陽出現：決定這一夜的是禁兵的近身刀槊與宮門封鎖。

kit.name: 斯巴達長矛
kit.history: 兩米長的木槍，槍尾帶銅套。方陣裡它比劍更早決定誰站得住。

countries: 神龍政變不是兩個國家之間的戰爭，而是唐都洛陽城內部兩個政治集團的一次武裝對峙，所以交戰方必須按陣營而不是按國家來分。一方是武則天晚年經營起來的內廷集團：以張易之、張昌宗兄弟控制中宮與文昌殿，在御前視事、判署奏議；以武三思為首的武氏族人分據尚書、右僕射與檢校諸道；韋氏與安樂公主在旁襄助；皇孫李隆基與李憲一系雖居儲位，權柄卻被架空。這一方掌握紫微城的內廷與近侍，能決定女皇的起居、奏對與對外發號施令的節奏。另一方是外朝與北衙禁軍組成的行動集團：張柬之、崔玄暐、敬雲石、桓彥范、蘇敬華、王孝傑等人分居中書、兵部、御史、司禮與洛陽令之位，另有張建之、范雲、袁恕己、太平公主與宗室李隆基策應，其中關鍵在於王孝傑以右武衛將軍之便掌握了北衙禁兵的調遣權。兩邊的指揮系統都靠唐代原有機構運作：外朝走中書門下政事堂，內廷靠司禮與中宮傳召，禁兵則分左右翊衛、左右驍衛、左右羽林、龍武、神武諸軍，加上萬騎，以及洛陽城內一百零三坊的坊門與宮門宿衛。政變當夜沒有州郡調兵，也沒有邊軍參與，衝突被壓縮在玄武門、迎仙院與千秋殿之間數百步的宮牆之內：一方靠宮門的鎖鑰與傳令的符契，另一方靠對宿衛班次的熟悉，以及一隊能在一夜之間轉向的直屬禁兵。
countriesEn: The Coup of 705 was not a war between two states but an armed confrontation between two political groups inside the Tang capital of Luoyang, so the belligerents have to be described as camps rather than as nations. On one side stood the court group that Wu Zetian had built up late in her reign: the brothers Zhang Yi and Zhang Changzong, who controlled the inner palace and the Wenchang Hall, received audiences in her presence and countersigned the memorials; the Wu clan under Wu Sansi, holding the ministries, the office of Right Pushe and the concurrent posts over the circuits; the Wei family, the empress's daughter-in-law, and Princess Anle assisting on the side; and the imperial grandsons Li Longji and the line of Li Xian, who occupied the position of heir but were pushed aside in real authority. This side held the inner palace of the Ziwei City, controlled the sovereign's daily routine and her audiences, and set the rhythm of every edict issued outside. The other side was the acting group assembled from the outer court and the Northern Garrison: Zhang Jianzhi, Cui Xuanwei, Jing Yunshi, Huan Yanfan, Su Jinghua and Wang Xiaojie, who sat in the Secretariat, the Ministry of War, the Censorate, the Directorate of Ceremonial and the office of the magistrate of Luoyang, with Zhang Jianzhi, Fan Yun, Yuan Shuji, Princess Taiping and the imperial clansman Li Longji joining in; what mattered above all was that Wang Xiaojie, as general of the Right Martial Guard, controlled the dispatch of the Northern Garrison troops. Both camps worked through the institutions the Tang already had: the outer court through the Chancellery of the Secretariat and Department of State Affairs, the inner court through the Directorate of Ceremonial and summons carried out of the inner palace, and the troops through the guard commands of the Left and Right Yiwei, Xiaowei, Yulin, Longwu and Shenwu, together with the Wanqi and the ward gates and palace watches of the hundred and three wards inside Luoyang. On the night of the coup no provincial troops were mustered and no frontier army was involved; the clash was compressed into the few hundred paces of palace wall between Xuanwu Gate, the Yingxian Court and the Qiutian Hall. One side held the locks of the palace gates and the tallies that carried orders; the other held its familiarity with the watch roster and a body of directly owned soldiers capable of changing direction inside a single night.
people: 直接動手的是六位外朝大員。張柬之最被後世視為首謀，他以中書令的身分在朝中往來周旋，是最早主張迎還唐室的重臣；崔玄暐掌中書，控制政令的出口；兵部尚書張建之掌兵符與武備調度；御史中丞敬雲石與司禮少卿桓彥范分別盯住監察與內廷傳召的關口；洛陽令蘇敬華熟悉城防與坊門的開合；右武衛將軍王孝傑是唯一能把禁兵帶到玄武門的人。范雲、袁恕己等奉連其間，太平公主在宮中出力最多，宗室李隆基那年不到二十歲，卻是預先知會、隨隊入宮的關鍵一環，政變後他進封秦王、任尚書右僕射，這條仕途的起點正是這一夜。目標一方：武則天是全場唯一必須被說服的人，她退位時仍保留太上皇的名號，並在同年十二月崩於上陽宮，享年八十一；張易之、張昌宗兄弟自694年起長期侍從左右，自704年入禁中後更攬權；武三思是武氏族中最後的掌權者，當夜被殺；韋氏與安樂公主被貶，前者在隨州、房州輾轉，後者於710年被迫自盡。背景人物尚有狄仁傑，他在683至686年間屢次請武則天立李顯、還李姓，政變發生時已不在相位，但那些奏疏在朝中留下了難以磨滅的底稿。登極者李顯此時已是皇太子，於政變當日即位，其弟李旦封皇太弟留守洛陽，三年後李旦即位，是為唐睿宗。
peopleEn: Six senior officers of the outer court struck the blow. Zhang Jianzhi is regarded by later historians as the first mover: moving about the court in his capacity as chief minister, he was the leading advocate of bringing the Tang house back. Cui Xuanwei controlled the Secretariat and therefore the outlet of government orders. The minister of war Zhang Jianzhi had charge of the military tallies and the movement of arms. The censor-in-chief Jing Yunshi and the assistant director of ceremonial Huan Yanfan watched the points where the censorial system and the inner court's summons crossed. The magistrate of Luoyang, Su Jinghua, knew the city walls and how the ward gates were opened and shut. Wang Xiaojie, general of the Right Martial Guard, was the only man who could bring the garrison troops up to Xuanwu Gate. Fan Yun and Yuan Shuji were drawn in among them; Princess Taiping did more inside the palace than anyone; and the imperial clansman Li Longji, then not yet twenty, was the one who was told in advance and entered the palace with the party, receiving afterwards the title Prince of Qin and the office of Right Pushe of the Department of State Affairs, so that the career of the future Emperor Xuanzong began with this very night. On the side that was struck, Wu Zetian was the only person who had to be persuaded; she kept the title of retired emperor after her abdication and died at Shangyang Palace in the twelfth month of the same year, aged eighty-one. The brothers Zhang Yi and Zhang Changzong had attended her continuously from 694 and drew still more power after entering the inner palace in 704. Wu Sansi was the last of the Wu clan to hold real power and was killed that night. The Wei family and Princess Anle were demoted, the former moving between Suizhou and Fangzhou, the latter forced to take her own life in 710. Behind them stood Di Renjie, who had petitioned Wu Zetian repeatedly between 683 and 686 to enthrone Li Xian and restore the Li surname; he was out of office when the coup came, but those memorials had left an indelible record in the mind of the court. The man who was enthroned, Li Xian, was already the crown prince; he took the throne the same day and his brother Li Dan was made heir apparent and left to hold the capital, becoming Emperor Ruizong three years later.
kits: 卡面那件斯巴達長矛是希臘重步兵的裝備：兩米上下的木槍，槍尾帶銅套，方陣中它用來接戰、纏鬥、撐住陣線，而不是用來投射。這件兵器從未出現在七○五年的洛陽，它在這張卡上說明的是另一件事——卡牌把這場政變選作「密集隊形如何決定局面」的案例。真正上陣的是唐的北衙禁兵。羽林、龍武、神武三軍與萬騎的骨幹是重裝步騎，裝備以明光鎧為主：兜鍪、護肩、鎧身、長裙，配橫刀與長槊。槊是漢唐長矛的高階型，刃部細長多帶血槽，握處纏皮或麻，騎兵在馬上用槊，步兵以槊桿配短刀，正是隊形衝鋒時真正伸出去的那一截，與長矛在方陣中的功能最為接近。弓弩方面，禁兵用臂弓與蹶張弩，箭壺與公用箭袋隨軍配置，宮門與坊門的守衛另備門弓與機弩，城樓上還有床弩一類的守具。內廷一側，張氏與武氏的私人部曲人數有限，靠的是宮中宿衛與閹宦傳令，面對的卻是有編制、有武庫存械、只差一紙調令的禁兵。運輸與糧秣在這一夜幾乎不構成問題：洛陽是東都，宮城、坊市、禁軍營署與武庫都在城內，禁兵由營到玄武門不過數里，既不必遠征，也沒有攻城器材——沒有投石機，沒有撞車，沒有雲梯。攻城技術的缺席正是政變與會戰的根本分別：當夜唯一的攻城手段是破門。
kitsEn: The dory on the card is the weapon of the Greek heavy infantry: a wooden shaft some two metres long with a bronze butt-cap, used in the phalanx to engage, to keep the fighting locked together and to hold the line, not to be thrown. This weapon never appeared in Luoyang in 705; what it contributes to the card is a different point — the card selects this coup as a case of how close order decides an outcome. What actually went into action were the Northern Garrison troops of the Tang. The core of the Yulin, Longwu and Shenwu guards and of the Wanqi was heavy foot and horse, equipped above all with the minghuang armour: helmet, shoulder guards, cuirass and skirts, together with the hengdao sabre and the long mao. The mao is the high-grade form of the Chinese spear, its blade long and slender and often grooved, its grip wound in leather or hemp; the mounted men used it from horseback and the footmen carried the shaft with a short sabre, and it was that projecting point which really decided a charge in close order, the closest functional cousin to the spear of the phalanx. For bows and crossbows the garrison used the single-arm bow and the strong arm crossbow, with quivers and communal arrow bags carried on the march, while the guards at the palace and ward gates were separately issued gate bows and mechanism crossbows, with bed crossbows of a sort on the wall towers. On the inner side, the private followers of the Zhang and Wu houses were few in number and relied on the palace watch and on eunuchs as messengers, and they were opposed by a garrison that had organisation, stored arms in its depots, and lacked only a single written order. Logistics and supply were hardly an issue that night: Luoyang was the eastern capital, and the palace city, the ward markets, the garrison barracks and the armouries all lay inside the walls, so the march from barracks to Xuanwu Gate was a matter of a few li. There was no long march to make and there were no siege engines at all — no stone-throwers, no battering rams, no ladders. That absence of siege technique is the essential difference between a coup and a pitched battle: the only form of assault available on that night was to break the door.
tactics: 這場行動的戰術核心是速度、封閉與突然，而不是會戰裡的陣形對撞。策劃者選在臘月，選在女皇臥病，選在中外朝制度交替的間隙動手：人員在坊內而非營中集合，以免被發覺；分兩路，一路由王孝傑所部的右武衛與羽林擔任攻擊主力，直取迎仙院，另一路控制玄武門與通往紫微城的宮門，同時封閉洛陽城門與坊門，切斷內廷與外朝之間的傳令與補給；動手之前先取武庫與兵仗，讓守方無兵可用。接戰發生在狹長的宮道與院門之間，夜裡視線短，弓弩的射程大受限制，主力靠的是短兵相接：槊刺、橫刀劈砍、長槍封住院門，以及在亂軍中對關鍵目標的精確撲殺。政變者沒有排成方陣——這正是它與斯巴達長矛最不相像、也最值得比照的地方：長矛方陣靠的是整齊到毫厘的線列與協同前推，能在平地上形成銅牆；洛陽宮中的夜襲靠的是相反的東西，靠的是禁兵對宮門值班、巡哨路徑與鑰匙交接的熟悉，靠的是目標本人集中在院內而不在野外所暴露的弱點，以及一支能在數百步內完成轉向的直屬部隊。整個行動從集結到逼宮不過一日，沒有拉鋸，也沒有第二天；這就是它勝得如此徹底、而又如此安靜的原因。
tacticsEn: The tactical core of this operation was speed, closure and surprise, not the collision of formations in a pitched battle. The planners chose the twelfth month, chose the time when the empress lay ill, and chose the gap between the routines of the inner and outer courts: the men mustered inside the wards rather than in the barracks so that they would not be noticed; the force was split in two, one body led by the Right Martial Guard and the Yulin under Wang Xiaojie as the striking force aimed straight at the Yingxian Court, the other taking Xuanwu Gate and the palace gates that led to the Ziwei City, while the city gates and the ward gates of Luoyang were closed to cut off the traffic in orders and supplies between the inner palace and the outer court; and before the blow fell, the depots of arms were seized so that the defenders would have nothing to fight with. The fighting took place along narrow palace roads and at the doors of courtyards; in the dark the line of sight was short and the range of bows and crossbows badly constrained, so the battle turned on close combat: the thrust of the mao, the cut of the hengdao, the spear sealing a doorway, and the precise finishing of the key targets in the mêlée. The conspirators did not form a phalanx — and this is exactly where the comparison with the dory is most instructive, because the difference is total. A phalanx of long spears depends on a file aligned to the hair and on a coordinated push forward, and it makes a wall of bronze on level ground. The night attack in the Luoyang palace depended on the opposite things: on the garrison's familiarity with the watch roster, with the paths of the night patrols and with the handing over of keys; on the weakness of a target who was concentrated inside a courtyard rather than out in the open; and on a directly owned body of troops able to turn its direction within a few hundred paces. The whole operation, from mustering to the forcing of the palace, took a single day. There was no seesaw of fighting and there was no second day. That is why it ended so completely, and so quietly.
data: 能站得住的數字大致如下，記載缺失的則不作推補。時間：政變發生在長安四年（公元705年）十二月，換算西曆是705年1月16日，當夜至次日完成；政變之後朝廷改元神龍，故史稱神龍政變；同年十二月武則天崩於上陽宮，享年八十一。人物：直接參與的核心大員六人，加上太平公主、李隆基、張建之、范雲、袁恕己等，連同率隊與傳令者，史書所記者數十人，再多不可考。兵力：北衙禁軍常額達十萬是開元以後的數字，神龍元年尚未如此膨脹；羽林、龍武、神武三軍各約三千人，萬騎亦只數千，右武衛與翊衛各有建制，實際投入的只是一支直屬隊伍，規模以數百人計，足以控制數座宮門而已。城市：隋唐洛陽城南北九里七十二步，東西七里一百二十步，城內一百零三坊，坊門夜閉；玄武門為紫微城南面正門，迎仙院在紫微城之內，千秋殿為女皇視朝之所，三者之間的距離以里計，步行可達。制度：武則天晚年設置的直訴投訴箱制度，政變後停用，渠道歸入中書與門下。時間刻度方面，中宗自政變當日即位，至710年崩，在位約四年八個月，其後睿宗、太平公主與李隆基先後秉政，再至713年先天政變改元開元，都可以對照。卡面那件長矛的年代比這場政變早一千五百餘年，其壽命遠長於它。
dataEn: The figures that can be stood behind are roughly as follows, and where the record is missing nothing has been reconstructed. On time: the coup took place in the twelfth month of the fourth year of Chang'an, which converts to 16 January 705 in the Western calendar, and it was finished between that night and the next day; the court changed the era name to Shenlong after the coup, which is why the episode is called the Shenlong coup; and in the twelfth month of the same year Wu Zetian died at Shangyang Palace, aged eighty-one. On persons: six senior officers were the core of the operation, with Princess Taiping, Li Longji, Zhang Jianzhi, Fan Yun, Yuan Shuji and others, and counting the men who led the detachments and carried the messages, the histories record a few dozen participants and no more can be established. On strength: a Northern Garrison of a hundred thousand men is a figure belonging to the Kaiyuan era and later, and in the first year of Shenlong the establishment was not yet so inflated; the Yulin, Longwu and Shenwu guards had about three thousand men each, the Wanqi numbered only several thousand, and the Right Martial Guard and the Yiwei had their own establishments, but only a directly owned detachment was actually committed, on the order of several hundred men, which was enough to hold a handful of palace gates. On the city: the Sui and Tang Luoyang was nine li and seventy-two paces by north and south and seven li and one hundred and twenty paces by east and west, and it held a hundred and three wards whose gates were shut at night; Xuanwu Gate was the main southern gate of the Ziwei City, the Yingxian Court lay inside that city, and the Qiutian Hall was where the empress held her audiences, the three being within walking distance measured in li. On institutions: the system of direct petition boxes that Wu Zetian had established in her late years was abolished after the coup and the channel folded back into the Secretariat and the Department of State Affairs. As a time scale, Zhongzong took the throne on the night of the coup and died in 710, reigning about four years and eight months, after which Ruizong, Princess Taiping and Li Longji in turn held power and the Xianfeng coup of 713 opened the Kaiyuan era — all of it available for comparison. The weapon on the card is more than fifteen hundred years older than this coup, and outlives it by that much.
cause: 政變的起因是多股不滿在同一個冬天疊加。第一是權力分配：張易之、張昌宗自704年入禁中，長年在御前視事，奏議要送兩兄弟過目，連宰相的班次都要看他們的臉色；武三思以武氏族主的身分把住尚書、右僕射與檢校諸道；韋氏與安樂公主在東宮與中宮之間上下其手，皇位繼承的方向被這批人捏在手裡。第二是正統問題：李唐的宗室與大臣把女主稱帝、國號周視為二十年的非常之舉，復唐在名分上是一個正當的要求；狄仁傑在683至686年就已屢次進諫，請立李顯、還李姓，那些奏疏在朝中留下了抹不去的記錄。第三是統治上的疲態：武則天晚年多病，政務多委於他人；對外則有北方的契丹與突厥、西方的吐蕃與突騎施，安西四鎮自武周中期失陷之後尚未收復，關內的轉運與兵役長期沉重；朝野求安的心切，使換一個人來做皇帝成了一件可以公開談論的事。第四是機會本身：臘月女皇臥病，中外朝的例行朝會稀疏，禁兵宿衛的調度恰在年節交接的縫隙，太平公主與宗室在宮中又有活動的餘地，於是外朝幾位重臣決定用一次夜襲把一切解決。骨子裡，這是二十年的權力積累，遇上了一次制度性的空檔。
causeEn: The coup came out of several discontents piling up in the same winter. First, the distribution of power: since entering the inner palace in 704 the brothers Zhang Yi and Zhang Changzong had spent their days in the sovereign's presence, memorials passed through their hands, and even the schedule of the chancellors was set by their moods; Wu Sansi, as head of the Wu clan, held the ministries, the office of Right Pushe and the concurrent posts over the circuits; the Wei family and Princess Anle quietly worked the space between the crown prince's residence and the inner palace, and the direction of the succession was in their hands. Second was the question of legitimacy: the Li house and the ministers of the Tang regarded a woman on the throne under the title Zhou as an abnormality of twenty years' standing, and restoring the Tang was a rightful demand in terms of principle; Di Renjie had already petitioned repeatedly between 683 and 686 to enthrone Li Xian and restore the Li surname, and those memorials left a mark on the court that could not be rubbed out. Third came the fatigue of government: Wu Zetian was often ill in her last years and much of the work was delegated; outside, there were the Khitan and the Turks in the north, the Tibetans and the Türgesh in the west, the four garrisons of Anxi had been lost since the middle of the Zhou period and not yet recovered, and the transport and conscription burden on the passes was a long-standing weight; the longing of the court and the country for peace made the exchange of the man on the throne a thing that could be discussed openly. Fourth was the opening itself: in the twelfth month the empress lay ill, the routine audiences of the inner and outer courts were thin, the rotation of the garrison watch fell across a gap in the turn of the year, and inside the palace Princess Taiping and the imperial clan still had room to move, so a handful of senior ministers of the outer court decided to settle everything with a single night attack. At bottom, this was twenty years of accumulated power meeting an opening in the machinery of the state.
impact: 政變結束了武周，也結束了中國歷史上唯一一次女主正式稱帝的統治，唐祚自此又延續了二百餘年。短期看：張氏與武氏的黨羽被清洗，韋氏與安樂公主被貶出宮禁，中宗李顯復位，追尊唐室先人，罷去武周時期的直訴箱制度與部分苛政，吏治為之一新；太平公主與李隆基在政變中同獲大功，成為中宗朝乃至睿宗朝真正的權力中心。但影響不止於此。政變本身就是一份政治文件：它說明唐的皇位歸屬可以在一夜之間由一支直屬禁兵與一道宮門的鑰匙決定，這條路一旦走通，後來的玄武門之變、興慶之變，以及開元之後節度使與禁軍的反覆，都沿着它延伸。政變之後的十年同樣值得留意：中宗朝韋氏與太平公主的權力競逐，710年韋氏與安樂公主被誅，睿宗朝二李與太平公主的角力，直至713年先天政變李隆基即位、玄宗開元，才把這條路收束成另一種秩序。政變沒有觸及唐代制度的根本，卻把「誰能掌握禁兵」這條真正的權力規則擺到了明處，成為中唐藩鎮與宦官政治、以及唐末神策軍政治的前奏。
impactEn: The coup ended the Zhou dynasty of Wu Zetian and with it the only reign in Chinese history in which a woman formally occupied the imperial title, and the Tang house went on for another two hundred years and more. In the short term the followers of the Zhang and Wu houses were swept away, the Wei family and Princess Anle were demoted out of the palace, Zhongzong Li Xian returned to the throne, the ancestors of the Li house were restored to their titles, the petition boxes and part of the harsh legislation of the Zhou period were abolished, and the tone of official life improved; Princess Taiping and Li Longji, who had both gained great credit in the coup, became the real centres of power under Zhongzong and under Ruizong alike. But the effects reach further than that. The coup is itself a political document: it shows that the ownership of the Tang throne could be settled inside a single night by a directly owned garrison and by the key of a single palace gate, and once that road was opened the later coup at Xuanwu Gate, the affair of Xingqing, and the recurring struggles of the frontier commands and the garrisons under Kaiyuan all ran along it. The ten years after the coup matter just as much: the rivalry between the Wei family and Princess Taiping under Zhongzong, the execution of the Wei and Princess Anle in 710, and the struggle between the two Li brothers and Princess Taiping under Ruizong, until the Xianfeng coup of 713 put Li Longji on the throne and the Kaiyuan era began, and the road was finally closed off into a different order. The coup did not touch the root of the Tang institutions, but it did place in the open the actual rule of power in that dynasty — who holds the garrison — and it is the prelude to the politics of the provincial commands and eunuchs in the middle Tang and of the imperial guards in the late Tang.
result: 結果是政變完全成功，而且代價小得驚人：一日之內，張易之、張昌宗在迎仙院伏誅，武三思與其黨羽一並被殺，韋氏被貶往隨州、其後再貶房州，安樂公主被幽於掖庭，女皇退位稱太上皇，皇太子李顯即位為唐中宗，其弟李旦封皇太弟、留守洛陽，同年十二月武則天崩於上陽宮。軍隊方面，禁兵沒有分裂，沒有嘩變，沒有地方軍鎮介入，史書對這一夜的記載甚至很少提到傷亡數字，因為它確實不是一場會戰：死的是宮中的侍從與黨羽，而不是任何一支成建制的部隊。政變之後，新朝大赦，追復被酷吏與武周政治所陷者，張柬之、崔玄暐、桓彥范、蘇敬華等分居要職，王孝傑以軍功進身；唐的名號恢復，改元神龍，史家遂以神龍政變或神龍革命稱之。留下的問題同樣清楚：中宗本人性格軟弱，韋氏復出，安樂公主仍然覬覦；政變五年之後中宗暴崩，睿宗李旦再度即位，太平公主與李隆基在713年的先天政變中再演一次宮廷政變，開元之治才由此展開。回頭看卡面那件斯巴達長矛，可以確定的只有一句：它與洛陽這一夜無關，它不曾出現在玄武門或迎仙院；真正決定結局的是禁兵站在哪一邊、宮門由誰開，以及那位已經高壽的女皇願不願意在朝臣面前退位。
resultEn: The result was a complete success, and at a startlingly small cost: within a single day the brothers Zhang Yi and Zhang Changzong were killed at the Yingxian Court, Wu Sansi and his followers were killed with them, the Wei family was demoted to Suizhou and later to Fangzhou, Princess Anle was confined in the Yeting, the empress abdicated as retired emperor, and the crown prince Li Xian took the throne as Emperor Zhongzong, his brother Li Dan being made heir apparent and left to hold the capital; in the twelfth month of the same year Wu Zetian died at Shangyang Palace. On the military side the garrison did not split, did not mutiny, and no regional command intervened; the histories of that night barely record a figure for casualties, because it was not a battle: those who died were attendants and partisans in the palace, not men of any formed body. After the coup the new court issued an amnesty, restored those ruined by the former officials and the politics of the Zhou period, and placed Zhang Jianzhi, Cui Xuanwei, Huan Yanfan and Su Jinghua in the highest offices, while Wang Xiaojie advanced on his military service. The name of the Tang was restored, the era was changed to Shenlong, and historians have accordingly called it the Coup of 705 or the Shenlong Revolution. The questions it left behind are equally clear: Zhongzong himself was weak in character, the Wei family came back to power, and Princess Anle remained ambitious; Zhongzong died suddenly five years after the coup, Ruizong Li Dan once more took the throne, and the night attack in the palace was staged a second time by Princess Taiping and Li Longji in the Xianfeng coup of 713, from which the Kaiyuan prosperity unfolded. Looking back at the dory on the card, only one thing can be said with certainty: it had nothing to do with this night in Luoyang, and it never stood at Xuanwu Gate or at the Yingxian Court. What decided the outcome was which side the garrison was on, who opened the palace gate, and whether the aged empress was willing to abdicate in front of her ministers.
